The rate of AMC (obtained as extended warranty cost or as separate pricing, where the ext ended warranty is unavailable) shall not exceed 6% of the actual purchase cost for the computer s ystem, accessories, and UPS except Servers. The actual purchase cost of hardware means the cos t excluding the additional warranty, anti-virus software, freight charges handling cost, GST, etc. In the case of CCTV, EPABX, FAX, LAN, active components-switch, modem, etc., Passive components in LAN such as CAT cable, I/O outlet, etc. shallnot be included under AMC. The AMC amount shall b e payable in 4 equal installments, 25% each on completion of every quarter of AMC, after deductin g the downtime penalty, if any in the contract period.
